We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly we need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know the molecule. Maybe the system expects we ask for carbon or proton NMR to deduce number of methyls. Could also be that the compound is known from context? No context given. So we need to get the spectra of the sample at hand. Use carbon_nmr_spectra or proton_nmr_spectra. The number of CH3 groups can be deduced from 1H NMR: methyl signals (singlet, doublet, etc) integrate to 3H each. But we don't have integration data. The tool likely returns a string with peaks and maybe integration. Could also use carbon NMR: methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm. Count distinct methyl carbon signals.

Thus we need to call carbon_nmr_spectra to get carbon NMR. Then count signals in methyl region (10-30 ppm). Let's do that.
